Got it. We’re going to add a Stripe‑based checkout to your Next.js app using **react‑easy‑stripe‑checkout‑pro**.

Because payments are involved, this falls under the **Amber** risk level, so we’ll start with a couple of quick questions to keep the setup safe and painless.

---

### Starter questions (amber)

1. **Do you already have a Stripe account and a Publishable key?**  
   If not, you’ll need to create one here: <https://dashboard.stripe.com/register>.

2. **Will users need to sign in before paying, or is it a one‑time “guest” checkout?**  
   If you need logins, we’ll set up a simple auth flow. If not, we’ll keep it simple.

Reply “yes” or “no” (and a short answer) to each. Then we’ll write a concise one‑screen plan and start the first step.
